rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a reciprocal or parallel relationship between things.

example.english: There is a correlation between these two things; they are not completely unrelated.
example.traditional: 呢兩件事有關聯，唔係完全冇關係㗎。
example.jyutping: ne1 loeng5 gin6 si6 jau5 gwaan1 lyun4 m4 hai6 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 gwaan1 hai6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a statistical measure showing the strength and direction of the relationship between variables.

example.english: The correlation coefficient between the two sets of data is close to one.
example.traditional: 分析結果顯示，兩組數據嘅相關係數接近一。
example.jyutping: fan1 sik1 git3 gwo2 hin2 si6 loeng5 zou2 sou3 geoi3 ge3 soeng1 gwaan1 hai6 sou3 zip3 gan6 jat1
